claims.claim_text: The indexed Wade J. Brightbill is probably the Navy radioman whom Wilkes College documented as a World War II member of the Sino-American Cooperative Organization.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A Wilkes institutional profile gives the same distinctive full name and documents 34 months in the Navy, including Sino-American Cooperative Organization service in China.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable from the uncommon exact full name and compatible specialized wartime service, but the index supplies no rank or private identifier and the institutional source does not mention an OSS personnel file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional source places the Navy service in World War II but does not establish whether it preceded, overlapped, or followed any OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: The finding is published as a qualified identity candidate only. Postwar Wilkes employment, later Naval Reserve commissioning, and undated education are not treated as pre-OSS evidence.

claims.claim_text: The index's printed Remsen Brincherhoff record is probably Remsen Brinckerhoff, whose grave-marker transcription identifies a World War II captain in the Office of Strategic Services.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A cemetery transcription records the distinctive corrected name, 1911-1969 dates, and a military marker for a captain in the Office of Strategic Services; NARA separately lists a donated collection under the same corrected name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable from the highly distinctive given name, one-letter surname variation, explicit OSS captain inscription, compatible era, and official NARA collection-name corroboration. The printed private identifier did not match an enlisted Army bulk record and has not been independently linked.
claims.temporal_assessment: The marker places the candidate in World War II OSS service but supplies no entry date or pre-OSS chronology.
claims.match_notes: The source-row spelling Brincherhoff remains immutable. Brinckerhoff is stored only as a probable documented variant pending Box 80 or an official service-number match.
